mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are 55 degrees with overcast skies as seen near the Military Ridge State Trail, and the moon is currently in a waxing gibbous phase.

The city has announced that chip sealing road maintenance begins on September 23. Affected areas include Cross Country Road, parts of East Verona Avenue, and Liberty Business Park, so please drive carefully in those zones. Also, the Plan Commission will review several development proposals on October 5, including new site plans and surveys.

We have a busy schedule ahead in Verona. Today, you can participate in Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, local trivia fans have plenty of options with Hop Haus Trivia, Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee, and Dream Day Trivia at Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead to later this week, don't miss the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market on September 23 or the highly anticipated Verona Fall Fest on September 25.

In a noteworthy call from the weekly report, officers responded on September 5 to a suspicious activity report where they found multiple vehicles with slices of cheese on their windshields, identified as a viral social media prank.
Culver's of Verona will be opening today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and enjoy today's featured flavor of the day once they unlock the doors.
